templates.subject_keys: week, market, fact-pack sha256, prompt-admission sha256
templates.launch: consumer child process: the launcher starts the rootless container (--network none, no env, no key) against the user gateway socket
templates.launch_inputs: the launcher reads RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/in/{task.json,bundle.json} and publishes RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/result.json; no per-task path is in the argv
templates.windows_cst: Linux windows of section 3.5; DeepSeek calls only off-peak (verified): Mon-Fri 00:00-09:00, 12:00-14:00, 18:00-24:00, weekends all day (agent calls outside this get RQ_PEAK_REFUSED -> DEFER)
templates.recovery_note: if the pro fallback already got an answer for this task_id the gateway refuses a second one (RQ_QUALITY_GATE_USED -> BLOCKED_DETERMINISTIC + remediation); a flash-only run repeats at flash cost

evidence_matrix_rows.evidence: calls[] vs gateway.sqlite; scan of out/

templates.subject_keys: week, market, fact-pack sha256, prompt-admission sha256
templates.launch: consumer child process (User=research-queue) hands the staged task to rq-agent.service through the spool /var/lib/rq-spool (in/ written by the consumer, out/ by the agent) and publishes the result; rq-agent.service is a timer-started oneshot (User=rq-agent, IPAddressDeny=any, AF_UNIX only) that drains the spool; no systemctl, no polkit rule
templates.launch_inputs: the consumer stages RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/in/{task.json,bundle.json}; the client copies them into the spool and publishes RQ_ATTEMPT_DIR/result.json (+ out/); no per-task path is in the argv
templates.windows_cst: NET tasks 10:45-21:45; DeepSeek calls only off-peak: weekdays 12:00-14:00 and 18:00-21:45, weekends 10:45-21:45 (all inside the verified off-peak table)
